title: Demonstrated-interoperability ledger (kind b)
description: One entry per recorded cross-platform execution: a real document sent by one platform and received by another. Conformance results are never entered here; they are conformance-implied (kind a) and live in the pair matrix. DRAFT.

platform.description: Platforms only. A stand-in used where the original is not reachable is never a party.

version.description: Commit, tag or release the party ran.

surface.description: Which component acted, for example a service, a wallet build or a handler set.

task.description: Trust Task slug, for example acl/list.

items.description: Repository-relative path or public URL of the recorded artefact (captured documents, logs, a run folder). An entry without an artefact is not admitted.

related.description: Conformance run folders or vector ids the entry relates to; informational.
